assumptions.simultaneousActions: client FIFO before expiry; equal expiries by service ID
assumptions.renewalAnchor: max(paymentAt, paidThrough); calendar month with clamping
assumptions.day: synthetic product, not verified Aeza tariff
assumptions.hourlyDeletionBoundary: auto off, 24h since last manual payment; purchase counts

monthlyDeletionPolicy.startsAt: financial suspension, not wallet exhaustion or account registration
monthlyDeletionPolicy.scope: monthly VPS/VDS, not physical dedicated servers

assumptions.monthlyDeletionBoundary: simulation: successful manual payment exactly at deadline precedes deletion; deleted tombstone retained for audit, no restoration
assumptions.monthlyRestrictionIntersection: simulation assumption, not verified Aeza rule: no deletion while nonfinancially blocked; existing financial deadline retained and checked on release; if expiry was blocked before any financial suspension, clock starts on release
assumptions.otherDeletionPolicies: daily and other hourly policies not simulated; not a guarantee of recoverability
assumptions.replacement: explicit same-owner paid replacement; separate auto-off; no refund
assumptions.nonfinancialRestriction: agreed simulation: no charges while restricted; paid clock unchanged
assumptions.release: no automatic payment, debt, credit or extension; ordinary hourly deletion resumes
assumptions.snapshotTransactions: omitted; all payments preserved in events; legacy API amount cap

provenance.historicalPrices: saved catalogue for demonstration, not historical quotes
